notes: This is an invented trip, here to show what the app does. Times and descriptions are examples: check everything before a real visit.
If it rains: swap this day with the next one. **Belém** has more places indoors.

stops.title: Praça do Comércio
stops.text: Start at the big square on the river, then walk under the arch into Rua Augusta.

stops.title: Lisbon Cathedral
stops.text: Ten minutes uphill. The tram line passes right in front of the door.

stops.title: Miradouro de Santa Luzia
stops.text: A terrace over the roofs of Alfama. A good place for a break.

stops.title: Castelo de São Jorge
stops.text: The castle on top of the hill. Tickets are sold at the gate.

stops.title: Lunch in Alfama
stops.text: No coordinates on this stop: it has no pin on the map, and that is fine.

stops.title: Miradouro da Senhora do Monte
stops.text: The highest viewpoint in the centre, best at sunset.

stay.name: Casa do Exemplo (invented)
stay.note: This hotel does not exist: it shows where the check-in notes go. **Bold** works here too.

stops.title: Mosteiro dos Jerónimos
stops.text: Go early: the queue grows during the morning.

stops.title: Pastéis de Belém
stops.text: The custard tarts, still warm. The queue for take-away moves fast.

stops.title: Torre de Belém
stops.text: A walk along the river to the tower.

stops.title: MAAT
stops.text: You can walk on the roof of the museum for free.

stops.title: LX Factory
stops.text: Shops and cafés in an old factory, under the bridge.

stops.title: Cais do Sodré
stops.text: Back towards the centre on the Cascais line from Alcântara-Mar, a few minutes.

stops.title: Dinner in Cacilhas
stops.text: The ferry crosses the river in about ten minutes. Fish restaurants along the quay, and the city lit up across the water.

days.title: A day out of town

stay.name: Casa do Exemplo (invented)

notes: A day with two alternative plans: pick one with the buttons below. The app remembers the choice.

stops.title: Train from Rossio
stops.text: About 40 minutes. This stop has no coordinates on purpose.

stops.title: Sintra station
stops.text: From here a bus climbs to the palaces.

stops.title: Palácio da Pena
stops.text: Bus 434 from the station, fifteen minutes uphill. The coloured palace on top of the hill.

stops.title: Quinta da Regaleira
stops.text: Gardens, tunnels and the spiral well.

stops.title: Sintra old town
stops.text: A coffee and a pastry before the train back.

stops.title: Train from Cais do Sodré
stops.text: About 40 minutes along the coast. Sit on the left for the sea.

stops.title: Cascais station
stops.text: From here the beach is a two-minute walk.

stops.title: Praia da Rainha
stops.text: A small beach between the rocks.

stops.title: Boca do Inferno
stops.text: A walk along the cliff to the sea arch.

days.title: Porto in a day
notes: Leave the luggage at the station lockers in São Bento and travel light.
The flight home is at 21:30: be at the airport by 19:30.

stops.title: Alfa Pendular to Porto
stops.text: From Santa Apolónia, about three hours. Seats are assigned: check the coach number.

stops.title: São Bento station
stops.text: Look up in the hall: twenty thousand azulejo tiles telling the history of Portugal.

stops.title: Livraria Lello
stops.text: The bookshop with the red staircase. The ticket is deducted from a book you buy.

stops.title: A francesinha
stops.text: The Porto sandwich: bread, meats, melted cheese and a beer sauce. One is enough for two.

stops.title: Ribeira
stops.text: Down the steep lanes to the river front, among the coloured houses.

stops.title: Dom Luís I bridge
stops.text: Cross on the upper deck, with the metro, for the view over the river and the port cellars.

stops.title: Back to São Bento for the luggage
stops.text: Metro line D from Jardim do Morro, two stops.

stops.title: Metro to the airport
stops.text: Line E from Trindade, about thirty minutes.

items.label: Card
items.text: One rechargeable card works on metro, trams, buses and trains.

items.label: Trams
items.text: The historic trams are crowded: board at the first stop.

items.label: Any emergency
items.text: 112 works across the EU, from any phone, free of charge.
